mapper.select: SELECT id, initiation_id, period, cost_type, source_id, source_type, description, amount, billable, allocated, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY cost_type, created_at
SELECT cost_type, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 AND period = #{period} GROUP BY cost_type
SELECT period, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(1) AS entry_count FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC
SELECT source_type, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY source_type
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0 AND UPPER(cost_type) = UPPER(#{costType})
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(level_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS level_code, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(1) AS entry_count FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(level_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT period AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM pmis_cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0 AND period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT #{limit}
